notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
Hi guys,
First: thanks to support our work! ː16bitHeartː

We released a new update for Dragon Climax! ːsteamthumbsupː

List of updates:
- Fixed some barrel glitches.
- Fixed input lag.
- Fixed some troubles with Xbox Controller.
- Fixed the glitch of the jump.
- Fixed some Achievements.

Thanks for your feedback, we hope release more updates in future! :)

notes.title: New update: DPAD, keyboard setup, more optimization
notes.notes:
Hi guys! :coffeed:
First, thank you for your support and your feedback! :16bitHeart:

:pizzad: We have released a new update, here the features: :pizzad:

- DPAD for Xbox controllers now works.
- Now you can remap the keyboard keys.
- Now you can select the port/input of your controllers.
- Fix some lag error with Windows 10.
- Fixed some glitches.

Thank you to playing Dragon Climax, we want improve our work to make a good experiece for all users! Thanks! :catd:
